description: Minimal cross-locale essentials — no setup, agent-friendly first impression.
Local dev utilities (uuid, hash, base64, jwtDecode, regexExtract) plus getCurrentTime and evalExpression from Starter 5.
Free Korean services (Upbit, Bithumb, iTunes K-pop, K-beauty search) plus getCurrentTime and evalExpression. No API key required.

Filesystem read pipeline (discover roots, read, list, grep, search, slice, sort, find, cut) plus getCurrentTime and evalExpression. Reads anywhere under your home directory; call listAllowedDirectories to see the roots, or set TOOL_STUDIO_FS_BASE to relocate the working directory.
Expose every default tool — no curation. Heavy MCP catalog.
